message.content:
Here are some of the most highly regarded crime‑thriller films released in 2020:

| Film | Director | Notable Cast | Why It Stands Out |
|------|----------|--------------|-------------------|
| **The Invisible Man** (2017) – *2020 re‑release* | Leigh Whannell | Elisabeth Moss, Oliver Jackson-Cohen | A tense, psychological thriller that blends horror with a modern take on domestic abuse and surveillance. |
| **The Trial of the Chicago 7** | Aaron Sorkin | Eddie Redmayne, Sacha Baron Cohen, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II | A courtroom drama that doubles as a political thriller, capturing the energy of the 1969 protest movement. |
| **The Hunt** | Thomas Vinterberg | Mads Mikkelsen, Alicia Vikander | A chilling story about a man falsely accused of child abuse, exploring paranoia and social media hysteria. |
| **The Irishman** | Martin Scorsese | Robert De Niro, Al Pacino, Joe Pesci | A sprawling mob saga that uses de-aging tech to weave decades of crime history into a single narrative. |
| **The Gentlemen** | Guy Ritchie | Matthew McConaughey, Charlie Hunnam, Hugh Grant | A fast‑paced, witty heist film that balances humor with gritty underworld intrigue. |
| **The Night House** | David Bruckner | Rebecca Hall, Nathan Lane | A psychological thriller that mixes supernatural elements with a deep exploration of grief and trauma. |
| **The Last Duel** | Ridley Scott | Matt Damon, Adam Driver, Jodie Comer | A historical crime‑drama that examines truth, justice, and gender dynamics in medieval France. |

These titles were either released in 2020 or had significant re‑releases that year, and they received critical acclaim for their storytelling, performances, and direction.
